hypothesis: Frozen contextual features may distinguish within-event same-B pairs from cross-B pairs better than native conditional slot assignments; alternatively both are weak. No global B identity is learned.
population: All authenticated1536 Phase76 training identities and24 historical tiny views; development cache removed without iteration. No validation or test use.
partition: For each category sort SHA256(phase78-probe:UID); first192 fit, remaining64 probe-assessment. Both partitions were used to fit the frozen scientific model, so assessment is event-disjoint only for new probe fitting, not independent generalization.
measurements: encoder and per-head node cosine pair similarity
native versus conditional-optimal unordered matching and ambiguity
per-event/category/source-size supports and background pair scores

probe.features: symmetric abs(left-right) and left*right on128 contextual encoder features; train-fit feature mean/std
probe.fit: 512 Adam updates,lr0.01,batch256; event-uniform among eligible fit B events and same/cross pair balanced; seed7809; fixed final checkpoint
probe.null: identical budget on per-event permuted constituent B labels preserving B/background support and B counts; frozen permutation seed7810; assess against real labels

decision_rule: Probe AUC/conditional assignment are diagnostic, never exact membership. A narrow intervention requires measured mechanism beyond tiny/probe-only success and a deployable target/inference contract; otherwise no scientific jobs. No automatic second diagnostic or campaign.
uncertainty: Report event-mean and pooled pair AUC separately; category-stratified event bootstrap2000 seed7811 for paired probe-minus-native event AUC, descriptive within-training uncertainty. No iid pair confidence or physical tagging claim.
scope_limits: Fixed70000 corpus,128/32/256 widths,unchanged checkpoints/normalization/constraints; physical tree,beam pool,p4 endpoints unavailable for flat memberships. Probe is new supervised fitting and not production training.
source_support: Pair analyses and probe fit exclude shared detector-source pairs and report their counts. Native node metrics keep original denominators. No event dropped. Correction after support guard, before any probe fit or outcome analysis.
correction: First diagnostic17109723 failed source-support guard before fitting; one corrected execution allowed, same1h2CPU16G bound, no requeue or changed scientific question.
